title: Settings not syncing across windows — new window doesn't reflect other window's settings
description:
Settings should be global across all open windows of the app/extension, but currently a new window does not pick up settings changed/set in another already-open window (e.g. theme, background, tab organization toggles, etc. — whatever is currently window-scoped instead of global).

Investigate:
1. How settings are currently persisted — likely `chrome.storage.sync` or `chrome.storage.local` calls in components/SettingsPanel.js (and mirrored meridian-extension/). `chrome.storage.sync`/`local` should already be shared across windows/contexts by nature — if settings still aren't reflecting live in other open windows, the likely causes are: (a) each window's UI only reads settings once at load/init and never listens for `chrome.storage.onChanged`, so an already-open second window doesn't pick up a change made in the first window until it's closed/reopened, or (b) some settings are being cached in a window-local variable/state that shadows storage after initial load, or (c) settings are incorrectly being written to a window/tab-scoped store instead of the shared sync/local storage.
2. Confirm expected behavior: settings changed in one window should propagate live (or at minimum on next load) to all other currently-open windows — no manual reload required, ideally listen for `chrome.storage.onChanged` and update UI/state reactively.

Fix wherever settings are read/written to ensure a single global source of truth, and that all open windows subscribe to changes rather than caching a stale local copy. Mirror the fix into meridian-extension/. This is a high-severity correctness bug — settings desync across windows is confusing/broken UX.
label: Bug

activity.content:
## Completed

- Added a comprehensive `chrome.storage.onChanged` subscriber so all settings-panel controls update from the shared sync store across open windows.
- Updated live Meridian pages to reapply theme/background settings, refresh local-search scope controls, and rerender tab organization when synced preferences change.
- Mirrored all runtime changes into `meridian-extension/` and added cross-window regression coverage.
